messages:
Marta: Quick sync — I'm sketching a compact playbook for automatic fallback rollouts. Need alignment on a couple things: degrade modes we surface, the triggers we show in the UI, and what operator shortcuts exist (preview, force-skip, rollback).

Jon: Nice. Can you list the triggers you want first? e.g. p95 latency, error rate, 5xx from runtime, model hallucination signals, token budget exceed?

Marta: Thinking minimal surface: (1) infrastructure errors (5xx / connection failures), (2) latency SLO breaches (p95 > threshold for X mins), (3) model-level failures (out-of-vocab / generation-time aborts), (4) quota exhaustion for dedicated pools.

Amy: Important: when fallback kicks in because of quota exhaustion on Dedicated, we need to surface which capacity pool was hit and whether we switched to hosted or a cheaper quantized variant. Otherwise billing/support freakout.

Sam: For the console UX: propose a compact matrix row per trigger that shows: trigger name, last-fired (humanized), sample request id (link), and a one-click preview to simulate fallback on 1% of traffic. Preview should be non-destructive and not touch telemetry counters.

Hina: Audit question — every automatic fallback event must write a structured audit entry with: trigger, signal-values, resolved-policy-id, operator-override (if any), and a human reason. Retention defaults to 90d but exportable. Also a "Why did you fallback" deep-link from the route details page would be great.

Jon: Agreed on structured audit. Also callout: we need to be careful about oscillation — if traffic flips between main and fallback rapidly, operators will see flapping. Need hysteresis knobs (cooldown windows, min-duration).

Marta: Yep — propose adding a per-policy hysteresis panel: cool-down (s), min-serve-duration (s), and max-swaps-per-minute. Defaults: 60s cooldown, 120s min duration, 2 swaps/min. Thoughts?

Amy: Defaults sound fine, but for Dedicated customers we should expose a tighter default (longer min-duration) so we avoid churn on reserved infra. Also show estimated cost delta in the policy preview panel — rough $/1000 requests if fallback used.

Sam: UX nit: preview toggle should show a simulated latency histogram and token-cost delta. We can reuse the sim runner from rollout-sandbox. Minimal UI: small inline modal with <SimResult /> and a copyable json of the simulated audit entry.

Marta: Example policy JSON for the editor (draft):

```json
{
  "policy_id": "red-quick-fb-1",
  "triggers": [
    {"type":"infrastructure_5xx","window_sec":60,"threshold":5},
    {"type":"latency_p95","window_sec":300,"threshold_ms":1200}
  ],
  "degrade_mode": "fallback_variant",
  "fallback_target": "gptq-small-v2",
  "hysteresis": {"cooldown_sec":60,"min_duration_sec":120}
}
```

Jon: Looks clean. How do we represent forced operator actions? e.g., operator forces fallback but it should still log the policy id and a note.

Hina: Add optional fields to the audit entry: operator_id, operator_action (force_on/force_off/rollback), and operator_note. UI should show a soft-confirm modal for force actions that displays impacted routes and cost delta.

Amy: Ops/SRE concern: what about alerting? We should emit an event to our alerting pipeline when fallback threshold crosses X in Y minutes or when the same request id hits fallback repeatedly. Maybe a sample alert rule we can recommend in the runbook.

Marta: Good. I'll draft a minimal runbook snippet: when fallback > 10% for 5m, page oncall, include sample request IDs and the sim preview link. Also recommend 'force-skip' if fallback is noisy and we know primary infra is fine.

Sam: One more: keyboard shortcuts for operators during incidents: 'p' preview, 'f' force fallback, 'r' rollback. Keep small and optional behind experimental flag.

Marta: Love it. Action items: 1) I'll draft UI mock with matrix + modal previews, 2) Jon/Hina: propose audit schema fields (I'll paste to doc), 3) Amy: estimate cost delta calc and where we surface it, 4) Sam: hook up rollout-sandbox sim API to modal. Back in 48h? :thumbsup:

Deploy Bot: Deployment notice — branch fallback-playbook/kpis -> staging completed (sha abc123).

Amy: :raised_hands: will review cost calc tomorrow.

Jon: I'll draft hysteresis matrix and add oscillation tests to the sim runner.

Hina: I'll sketch the audit schema and retention/export endpoints.

Marta: Great, thanks team. Posting the initial mocks + policy JSON to the doc in 30m.
